shared_elements: carved human-like face/head in frontal or profile view
relief carving of a figure on a slab
justification: Both surfaces bear a carved anthropomorphic image on a stone slab, but A shows an elaborately detailed winged, bearded figure in profile with rendered hair, feathers, garment patterning and a flowering plant, while B shows only a crudely schematic face with simple eyes, nose and mouth on a plain upright block. The correspondence amounts to the universal fact that both depict a human face; the conventions of rendering (dense naturalistic detail vs minimal incised features) and the accompanying elements share nothing specific.
